title: Gemless Ring

sources.title: Ringless Gem
markers: | description = The '''Ringless Gem''' is a common yet one-of-a-kind [[Miscellaneous|Miscellaneous Item]] that can be combined with the [[Gemless Ring]]. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to [[Traders]].

summary: Combine with the Ringless Gem to make a Tarnished Ring. Learning about this ring can also unlock a trader’s special stock.

fields.Trade interaction: Use Speak with Dead on the refugee corpse Garrett and learn about the ring. This lets the party access Ferg Drogher’s special stock without the usual check.
fields.Crafted result: The game produces a Tarnished Ring with no documented power. The internal Magic Ring name does not appear on the crafted item.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
